lines.t: I hear Your voice, my Holy King
Calling me out from the gathering
Of hollow traditions built by human hands
The heavy customs of these shifting lands
They claim I’m turning from the ones I love
But my eyes are fixed on the Truth above
You told me to run from what You despise
To open my eyes to the world's disguise
⁠[Chorus]⁠
I choose You first, my Savior, my Lord
Your holy Word is my shield and sword
Let the division now be made clear
Your perfect love has cast out my fear
I leave behind the holidays of men
To walk in Your light again and again
Your Bride is waiting, pure and set apart
With Your holy Law engraved on my heart
⁠[Verse 2]⁠
They compromise to keep the peace
But in Your truth, I have found release
To honor a parent by breaking Your law
Is a subtle deception without any flaw
I will not bow to the doctrines of pride
Or walk in the valley where the worldly abide
I’ll take up my cross and follow Your feet
Where the love of the Father is made complete
⁠[Bridge]⁠
You are the goal where the Torah aims
The only foundation my spirit claims
I hear You call to repent and be free
To stand apart and delivered be
So I turn my back on the world's applause
And yield my soul to Your righteous laws
⁠[Chorus]⁠
I choose You first, my Savior, my Lord
Your holy Word is my shield and sword
Let the division now be made clear
Your perfect love has cast out my fear
I leave behind the holidays of men
To walk in Your light again and again
Your Bride is waiting, pure and set apart
With Your holy Law engraved on my heart
⁠[Outro]⁠
I call on Your name, YahuShua, my King
To Your holy presence, my soul will cling
Separate, faithful, delivered, and true
My beautiful Savior... I choose only You
⁠[Fade Out]⁠
⁠[End]⁠
